title: IRQHandler_RcCalib whole-handler qemu-arc proof (frame+body+rtie) and typo-RAM install
reason: User accepted composed EM_IRQ_HANDLER frames (not byte-identical) and required a whole-handler semantic proof vs stock in QEMU-ARC, then typo-install RcCalib first.

harness.irq_mode: spec irq=1 seeds and hashes r0-r12, r30, r58, r59, lp_count, lp_start, lp_end, and aux 1409/1411 after return; memhash and callhash unchanged
harness.osub: lr/sr of aux 1409/1411 (also 0x581/0x583) rewritten to ld/st of 0xfff010/0xfff014 (same 8-byte limm width). rtie rewritten to j [blink] after the frame restores blink. Matches unindented inline-asm lines from __asm__. All-exception-path irq runs are RUN FAILED.
harness.first_vacuous_attempt: osub required leading whitespace so 1409/rtie were not rewritten; every test took ret=0xdd000002 (instruction error). Fixed; a classes=1 calls=0 irq result is not a proof.

qemu_prove.orig: lowered stock 0x3064fc-0x30660c via .waves/lower.py, symbol renamed to opencfw_em9305_IRQHandler_RcCalib (frame kept)
